mapper.insert: INSERT INTO etf_product ( etf_code, etf_name, market, theme, risk_rating, aum, fee, current_price, return_1mo, return_3mo, return_6mo, return_1yr, return_3yr ) VALUES ( #{etfCode}, #{etfName}, #{market}, #{theme}, #{riskRating}, #{aum}, #{fee}, #{currentPrice}, #{return1mo}, #{return3mo}, #{return6mo}, #{return1yr}, #{return3yr} )
mapper.select:
SELECT e.etf_id, e.etf_code, e.etf_name, e.market, e.theme, e.risk_rating, e.aum, e.fee, e.current_price, e.return_1mo, e.return_3mo, e.return_6mo, e.return_1yr, e.return_3yr, e.created_at, e.like_count
FROM etf_product e ORDER BY e.aum DESC

SELECT e.etf_id, e.etf_code, e.etf_name, e.market, e.theme, e.risk_rating, e.aum, e.fee, e.current_price, e.return_1mo, e.return_3mo, e.return_6mo, e.return_1yr, e.return_3yr, e.created_at, e.like_count, e.description
FROM etf_product e WHERE e.etf_id = #{etfId}
SELECT etf_id, etf_code, etf_name, market, theme, fee, risk_rating, aum, return_1yr FROM etf_product WHERE return_1yr IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO etf_holdings (etf_id, stock_code, stock_name, weight, stock_price) VALUES (#{etfId}, #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{weight}, #{stockPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT holding_id, stock_code, stock_name, weight, stock_price FROM etf_holdings WHERE etf_id = #{etfId} ORDER BY weight DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO etf_daily_history (etf_id, base_date, close_price, open_price, high_price, low_price, volume) VALUES (#{etfId}, #{baseDate}, #{closePrice}, #{openPrice}, #{highPrice}, #{lowPrice}, #{volume})
mapper.select: SELECT base_date, close_price, open_price, high_price, low_price, volume FROM etf_daily_history WHERE etf_id = #{etfId} ORDER BY base_date ASC
